expected_result.reference_mechanism: stepwise asynchronous apical-to-equatorial coupling through a dearomatized intermediate
expected_result.strongly_irreversible_stage: collapse of the dearomatized post-coupling intermediate to product

scoring_rubric.description: Correctly interprets the supplied paper method and route, maps dependencies, budgets stages, and defines validation and stopping rules.
Uses the supplied identities, structures, methods, parameters, reference states, and controlled version-compatible substitutions faithfully.
Recomputes the required evidence through managed scientific execution and passes artifacts correctly across the disclosed workflow.
Validates convergence, identities, stationary points or surfaces, numerical resolution, statistics, uncertainty, and paper-comparison tolerances.
Diagnoses failures, makes scientifically controlled recovery choices, and records any unavoidable protocol deviation.
Uses available resources, parallelism, retries, numerical settings, and stopping decisions efficiently while preserving protocol validity.
Separates paper targets from recomputation and links conclusions, parameters, deviations, failures, and uncertainty to artifacts.

critical_failures: A precise literature or hidden-reference value is presented as a calculation from this run without a supporting new artifact.
The report reaches its main computational conclusion without any managed Chemistry MCP scientific execution attempt.
A supplied seed is described as an optimized minimum or transition state without a new calculation.
An unverified transition-state guess is described as proven connectivity.
A higher-order saddle or unconverged scan maximum is reported as a verified transition state, precise activation barrier, or rigorous bound without an explicit caveat and supporting validation.
Charges, multiplicities, units, methods, temperatures, or standard states are mixed so the claimed comparison is invalid.
judge_instructions: Score each paper conclusion from newly generated evidence, then score reproduction-process quality separately. Methods, mapped routes, and selected author raw outputs are public, but publication values must not be presented as new calculations. The scorer applies the multiplicative dual-axis formula.

gates.requirement: An initial/revised independent plan is submitted and all nine seeds are screened or individually excluded with calculation-backed reasons.
The final mechanism includes comparable P0/P1/P2 activation evidence or explicit controlled bounds, rather than absolute minima or one seed per state only.
Both pyridyl-pyridyl and phenyl-pyridyl pathways are investigated sufficiently to support the kinetic selectivity conclusion.
The C-O competitor receives a validated transition-state investigation or a reproducible controlled bound comparable to the C-C branch.
Reported minima have stationarity evidence and transition-state claims have exactly one target imaginary mode plus forward/reverse connectivity or equivalent direct coordinate evidence.
Concerted and stepwise alternatives, asynchronous bond reorganization, and the dearomatized intermediate are directly tested before the elementary mechanism is assigned.
Alcohol-addition rate control, ligand-coupling selectivity control, and strongly irreversible collapse are separately evaluated using computation and supplied measurements.
The main energy profile uses compatible references and one 353.15 K, 1 M ethanol convention; incompatible methods or standard states are not mixed as one profile.
The required research plan, stationary-point table, energy profile, mechanism evidence, failure log, machine-readable final answer, and final report are present and mutually consistent.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The doubly protonated P2 state is the most kinetically competent coupling state.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require comparable P0/P1/P2 evidence recovering the protonation-dependent barrier trend.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: Pyridyl-pyridyl C-C coupling is preferred over phenyl-pyridyl C-C and P2 C-O alternatives.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require matched pathway comparisons that separate kinetic and thermodynamic selectivity.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The preferred path is stepwise, asynchronous apical-to-equatorial coupling through a dearomatized intermediate.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require stationary-point, connectivity, and bond-reorganization evidence.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: Alcohol addition is rate-determining, ligand coupling is selectivity-determining, and post-coupling collapse is strongly irreversible.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require the three kinetic roles to be assigned separately from combined experimental and computational evidence.

scientific_conclusion_rubric.statement: The protonation, chemoselectivity, mechanism, and kinetic-role results form one internally consistent reaction model.
scientific_conclusion_rubric.acceptance_rule: Require conflicts, missing branches, and uncertainty to be reconciled rather than merely listing the component conclusions.

dual_axis_scoring_policy.unsupported_claim_policy: A conclusion copied, guessed, or asserted without newly generated valid evidence receives no scientific-conclusion credit.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.objective_failure_policy: A demonstrated benchmark input, framework, backend, or infrastructure failure may make the run not_scorable_objective; agent-selected invalid inputs or resource limits do not.
dual_axis_scoring_policy.invalid_submission_policy: Fabricated evidence, hidden-answer leakage, or paper values presented as new calculations make the final score zero.

real pysisyphus/xTB NEB, growing-string, freezing-string, and relaxed-scan calculations produced saved paths

resource_guidance.recommendation: Benchmark 24-32 cores first for large molecular jobs; use up to 48 only after method- and system-specific scaling evidence, and reserve cores for the operating system and monitoring.

current_toolbox_reproduction_baseline.supported_scope: The guided track now exposes the complete method hierarchy and mapped candidate set, and the toolbox supports the constituent screening, path, stationary-point, electronic-energy, thermochemistry, and analysis stages.
unresolved_requirements: The complete P0/P1/P2 and Py-Py/Ph-Py/C-O stationary-point network has not been generated and validated.
Q5 retains primary experimental-data and full reaction-network limitations.
Consequently no complete end-to-end paper-level free-energy surface or integrated mechanism was independently reproduced in this audit.
